text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your hard work, Trainer! You're really giving it your all, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: And you know, that time of year has finally come again!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Tracen Academy's annual summer camp will soon begin!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: That's right! ♪ You'll be staying by the beach, and utilizing the venue for a change in training programs.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'm sure the new environment will help your trainee improve in leaps and bounds!
color_text_info_list: help your trainee improve in leaps and bounds

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Camp starts in July, so make sure she's in tip-top condition to dive in and make the most of it.
color_text_info_list: make sure she's in tip-top condition

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: But it'll be over before you know it! You won't have much time to rest.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's what I want to hear! Summer camp is going to be so much fun! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Of course, training should be our foremost concern, but…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Once in a while, you should go to the beach for some recreation! It might be good for you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I think your trainee will feel refreshed and invigorated!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Although it's only a short period of two months from July through August…
color_text_info_list: two months from July through August

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I hope you'll spend a fruitful summer with your trainee! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tazuna tells me all about summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to pay attention to <chrname>'s condition and energy leading up to it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It starts two turns from now in early July, so I should probably start preparing now.
color_text_info_list: starts two turns from now in early July
